name: airep-sdk-local-pause-samples-v1
clock: Monotonic elapsed nanoseconds within one invocation; no ordering across runs or hosts is inferred
input: Exact SDK hook bundle, separate operator trust and explicit expected identity
scope: A first-party report of cooperative pause at one instrumented synchronous node and matching file samples; no continuous stopping, causal enforcement, total target coverage, durable restart or independent observer
native: Unmodified 0.2.0-beta.1 verifier and reconciliation outputs remain separate. Exit zero means evaluation completed. MATCH is only this explicit local policy.

covers: First-party report from one instrumented synchronous node and optional file samples
does_not_cover: Production key management or hard cancellation

artifact_scope_admission: Every signed artifact must have exactly artifact_scope, including list order and all exclusions. Expanded, missing or otherwise altered scope is NO_MATCH with a constant diagnostic. This closed mapping contract does not classify arbitrary scope prose.

source_admission.native_interrupts: Only the exact hook control interrupt is admitted; application interrupts and foreign next-node names are rejected before evidence serialization.
source_admission.sample_order: dispatch <= initial sample start <= initial sample end <= receipt <= native result <= final sample start <= final sample end <= effect event
